## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      20 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 8 jun 2026 - 27 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _YoloWojtek_, 27 ago 2026, 1/5: "The app constantly freezes and crashes. It often stops responding and then closes by itself, which makes it extremely frustrating to use. I’ve tried using it several times, but the problem keeps happening. Please fix these stability issues in an update."
            2. _Mugensai_, 27 ago 2026, 1/5: "J’ai fait le questionnaire puis une fois les limites de temps d’écran choisis l’appli crash et ne peut être ouverte. Donc apr avoir installé l’app je n’ai pas pu l’utiliser."
            3. _safealmondmilk_, 26 ago 2026, 1/5: "Used to have this app and it genuinely helped me get my phone usage way down. But then it updated (assuming to collect more data on users bc it asks so many invasive questions now - also notifies you to constantly open the app for no reason) making it unusable after it finally asks you do you want the premium version. The app loads a black screen and then closes itself, not worth the redownload. Disappointing that prioritizing greed killed a perfectly fine app."
